general_ml.label: General ML / Train-Val-Test Split
general_ml.rationale: A 60/20/20 train/val/test split requires ~1000 rows to produce a validation set large enough for reliable metric estimation. Below this, evaluation variance dominates reported performance.

linear_model.label: Linear / Logistic Regression
linear_model.rationale: Linear models estimate one coefficient per feature. Fewer than 20 rows per predictor produces unstable coefficient estimates with wide confidence intervals (Harrell 2001).

tree_model.label: Tree-Based Models (RF, XGBoost, LightGBM)
tree_model.rationale: Tree models are less sensitive to the rows-per-feature ratio but still require enough samples to find meaningful splits. Below ~100 rows, overfitting risk is severe.
